name: uberasm-reset-level-on-falling-down-offscreen
title: Reset Level on Falling Down Offscreen
description:
This UberASM works as Level and Game Mode 14 ASM. Instead of dying when falling offscreen, the level will restart as if you reentered it from the overworld.

Note: This doesn't work on level 24 unless you disable it's gimmick in Lunar Magic!
